title: M9-C42.26 — Full-Campaign Decision Gate, Measurement Cadence, and Verification Architecture Forward Dependency

full_campaign_decision_gate.decision: NO 14-component full mutation campaign is required for C42.26.
full_campaign_decision_gate.rationale: M26.10 explicitly enumerates the trigger conditions for a fresh repository-wide campaign. None of them are met.

production_source_changed_materially_acr.evidence: git diff 6bb27a89..HEAD -- src/engines/ is empty. No source changes to any 12-component engine source file.

mutation_configuration_changed_materiall.evidence: mutmut 3.7.0, pytest 9.1.1, Python 3.12.3, config_hash unchanged since C42.24-B. mutation_contract.py got +3 lines (behaviour_engine discovery repair) which is already in C42.24-B's measured state.

mutation_infrastructure_changed.evidence: No infrastructure change since C42.24-B measurement. Runtime foundation lint edits (F841/B007/C401/I001/F821) are non-behavioral.

population_fingerprints_changed.evidence: C42.24-B 12-component population identity preserved; 2 intelligence components ADDED (not modified). C42.25 targeted evidence is for the new components only and is internally consistent.

C42_25_evidence_cannot_be_reconciled.evidence: C42.25 evidence reconciles cleanly: not_checked=0 for both, comprehensive operator coverage, capability binding + discovery validated.

evidence_schemas_are_incompatible.evidence: Both evidence sources use the same mutmut summary schema (killed/survived/no_tests/timeout/suspicious/not_checked/total_mutants/mutation_score). Schema-compatible.

targeted_measurements_reveal_cross_compo.evidence: No targeted measurement has indicated cross-component interference. The 12 components and 2 intelligence components are independent code paths.

future_milestone_explicitly_requires_fre.evidence: C42.26's purpose is population expansion and intelligence certification. No future milestone forces a fresh full campaign at this point.

full_campaign_decision_gate.verdict: REUSE C42.24-B + C42.25 certified evidence and mathematically reconcile. This is the correct, forensic-rigorous operation.

measurement_cadence.principle: Do not run the entire population merely because several tests were added. This saves substantial execution time while preserving evidentiary rigor.

targeted_mutation.scope: ONE component (or sub-component) at a time. Bounded by mutmut 3.7.0 targeted mode.
targeted_mutation.typical_duration_seconds: 10-1200 depending on engine size and test scope
use_after: a discovery repair (no_tests -> 0 for a module)
a mutation-infrastructure change (e.g., mutmut version bump, config_hash change)
a specific production component change (single-engine source modification)

full_mutation_campaign.scope: Entire declared population (currently 14 components, but conceptually 'all engines in current population').
full_mutation_campaign.typical_duration_seconds: 3000-4500 (full repo full campaign, C42.21 was 4419 mutants / C42.24-B was 11730 mutants ~3360s)
use_only_at: POPULATION EXPANSION (new components admitted to the mutation scope; C42.26 was the only one to date)
MAJOR ARCHITECTURE CHANGES (refactor that changes module boundaries or test selection)
VERIFICATION FRAMEWORK CHANGES (mutmut version bump, mutation_contract.py material change)
PERIODIC CONVERGENCE CHECKPOINT (e.g., every 3-6 months or per-milestone)

do_not_run_full_merely_because: several tests were added in a single bounded strengthening batch (use targeted)
a small module was refactored (use targeted on that engine)
a survivor inventory is needed (use per-mutant dump from existing run, no re-execute)
a confidence check is wanted (use targeted on a sub-population)
measurement_cadence.trigger_for_full_campaign: Any of: (a) population expansion; (b) material mutation config change; (c) material infrastructure change; (d) periodic convergence checkpoint; (e) explicit final-certification requirement. C42.26 met none of these for the 14-component population.

verification_architecture_implication.principle: Capture the architectural requirement emerging from the C42.26 workflow. Do not implement the architecture in this phase unless required; record it as a forward dependency.
verification_architecture_implication.current_gap: The verification framework has no first-class concept of evidence reuse. Each new phase must re-establish baseline integrity manually, decide whether to rerun, and produce a fresh artifact. This is correct for forensic rigor but expensive and prone to inconsistency.

forward_required_concepts.purpose: Formal declaration that a prior component measurement remains valid for the current population scope. Includes: measurement run_id, source_commit, source_tree, config_hash, mutmut_version, pytest_version. Reusable across population expansions.

A first-class object representing a single component's mutation evidence. Fields: component, source_paths, test_paths, generated, killed, survived, no_tests, timeout, not_checked, score_pct, evidence_kind, run_id, frozen_at, freshness_window.

A first-class object representing a frozen declaration of the mutation population at a point in time. Fields: population_id, components, declared_at, declared_by, predecessor_population_id, population_kind (full, targeted, hybrid).

A first-class object representing an aggregate that is NOT a measurement but a deterministic combination of inputs. Fields: aggregate_id, inputs (list of ComponentMeasurement ids), formula, raw_value, rounded_value, disclaimers.

A formal signal that a prior ComponentMeasurement is no longer valid for a given PopulationSnapshot. Fields: component, prior_measurement_id, invalidation_reason, evidence (source diff, config diff, etc.), invalidation_date, suggested_remediation.

verification_architecture_implication.implementation_dependency: Forward-deferred to M9-C42.28+ (Unified Evidence Architecture) and M9-C42.27 (Verification Graph + Planner). These already exist in the C42.21 forward-architecture-scan as future workstreams.
verification_architecture_implication.recording: Recorded here as a C42.26 forward convergence dependency. Not implemented in C42.26.
